findings.detail: Path-only cache reuses stale hashes after byte mutation and caches None failures after repair.
Direct-file input is ignored despite CLI docs; missing root returns empty successful update and removes old cache entries.
--top-n1 breaks only inner distance tier, producing3pairs across3tiers.
Overlapping roots hash a path once; deleted paths evicted; zero hashes skipped.

Async fork has no elapsed deadline/RSS limit; select has no timeout. Exceptional cleanup sends SIGTERM to pending children without waitpid or closing pending read descriptors. Normal completed children are waited; do not claim all paths leak.
No source/dependency generations, model/library recipe cache identity, exact pixel confirmation or atomic cache replacement. Optional feh supports shell/delete actions; not executed.

extraction: Unchanged3FunctionDef bodies; Python3 imap/xrange/viewitems/viewvalues adapters, mocked hash provider, serial mode. No native hashing/fork/viewer execution.
scope: Bounded path-cache, enumeration and CLI behavior with original function bodies and adapters. No exact Python2/libpHash environment, image-hash precision, asynchronous child lifecycle or feh/delete qualification. No adoption.
control_harness_initial_failure: First helper attempt used int.bit_count unavailable in Python3.9; replaced only hash adapter with bin(xor).count(1), retained initial task directory and executed new v2 directory. Not an upstream failure.
